approved: A New Tax System (Goods and Services Tax) Amendment (Make Electricity GST Free) Bill 2017
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
The bill would remove the goods and services tax from electricity supplies.
It would take effect from the first day of the quarter after Royal Assent.
The government says a typical household could save around $200 each year.
Makes a supply of electricity GST-free.
Overrides the previous commitment to vary the GST base only with unanimous state and territory support.
Reduces GST revenues granted to state and territory governments by around $2 billion each year.
Households, low-income households, state and territory governments, and the Commonwealth budget.

The majority voted against a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2017-09-07.8.8) to agree with the bill's main idea. In parliamentary jargon, they voted against reading the bill for a second time. This means the bill failed and will no longer be considered in Parliament. ### What was the bill's main idea? The [bill](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/s1085) was introduced "*to remove goods and services tax from the supply of electricity.*"
